svg.title: TerraGate system map, mobile layout
svg.desc: A mobile reading layout of TerraGate's bounded Terraform review: deterministic Python checks, snapshot-bound evidence, separate human decisions, Neon state, expiring Lambda temporary files, human-controlled release, mocked GitHub writes, and disabled Terraform execution.

text.tspan: Review the exact plan.
Keep approval bounded.
Live constrained demo · deterministic Python checks
GitHub writes mocked · Terraform execution disabled

svg.text: THE REVIEW PATH · TOP TO BOTTOM

text.tspan: Upload Terraform plan JSON or choose a sample;
the review UI runs on Cloudflare Workers.
API Gateway routes to Lambda / FastAPI through
Mangum. The public demo does not run Terraform.

g.text: Trace the finding to its evidence

text.tspan: Redacted before / after values, unknown inputs,
rule provenance, and plan integrity stay visible.
Neon stores snapshot, findings, policy state,
human decisions, and audit history.
An exception applies to one finding and expires;
a different admin records it. Comment approval is separate.
Remediation snippets are export-only; GitHub
writes are mocked. No merge or apply authority.

g.text: Snapshot · finding · scoped decision · audit history
Instance-local files can expire; retrieval may return HTTP 410.

text.tspan: Manual Lambda release; Cloudflare release is separate.
RDS / VPC is a Terraform reference alternative.
Shared development identities; external GitHub writes
are mocked; Terraform execution is disabled. A recorded
risk decision never authorizes deployment.
